description: Financial, parent-child, TOCSV, LINEST, window functions and NAMEOF. No expected results yet: they wait for a recording from Power BI Desktop (tools/dax-record).

cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("v", PATHITEM("1|2|5", 2), "i", PATHITEM("1|2|5", 2, INTEGER), "r", PATHITEMREVERSE("1|2|5", 1), "x", PATHITEM("1|2|5", 4))
EVALUATE ROW("v", TOCSV(TOPN(2, Product, Product[ProductKey], ASC)))

DEFINE MEASURE Sales[T] = SUM(Sales[Quantity])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Date[Year], Date[MonthNumber], "prev", CALCULATE([T], OFFSET(-1, ALLSELECTED(Date[Year], Date[MonthNumber]), ORDERBY(Date[MonthNumber]), PARTITIONBY(Date[Year])))) ORDER BY Date[Year], Date[MonthNumber]

DEFINE MEASURE Sales[T] = SUM(Sales[Quantity])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "t", [T], "rank", RANK(SKIP, ALLSELECTED(Product[Category]), ORDERBY([T], DESC))) ORDER BY Product[Category]

DEFINE MEASURE Sales[T] = SUM(Sales[Quantity])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "n", ROWNUMBER(ALLSELECTED(Product[Category]), ORDERBY(Product[Category]))) ORDER BY Product[Category]

DEFINE MEASURE Sales[T] = SUM(Sales[Quantity])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "first", CALCULATE([T], INDEX(1, ALLSELECTED(Product[Category]), ORDERBY(Product[Category])))) ORDER BY Product[Category]

DEFINE MEASURE Sales[T] = SUM(Sales[Quantity])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "running", CALCULATE([T], WINDOW(1, ABS, 0, REL, ALLSELECTED(Product[Category]), ORDERBY(Product[Category])))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
